summary:
The app is amirsanni's Video-Call-App-NodeJS, a WebRTC, socket.io and Express conference-call app. I saved 2 views:
1) call-with-chat (/join, then click #toggle-chat-pane): the call room with its navbar controls and the open chat pane. The pane shows the team's weekly sync messages, auto-linked URLs and the message box.
2) create-room (/): the Create Room form, with Room Name and Your Name fields and a button.

Not saved:
- **Record dialog (Record video / Record screen / Close):** it opens fine, but on its own it failed the replay check three times at 0.67 text similarity (0.75 needed). The likely cause is the random Unique Identifier, which makes up most of that screen's text. When I opened it over the chat pane instead, it was rejected as a near-duplicate of the chat view.
- **'Your Name' form (/?room=...):** skipped as a near-duplicate of Create Room.

There is no camera in this environment, so the local video preview stays empty.
